description: A CSS file defining styles for a frontend application, including themes, layout, buttons, and cards.

classes.name: container
classes.description: A class that sets the width and maximum width for responsive layout, and centers content.

classes.name: btn
classes.description: A base class for buttons, providing padding, border, background color, and hover effects.

classes.name: btn-primary
classes.description: A specialized button class for primary action buttons with a gradient background.

classes.name: badge
classes.description: A class for badge elements, providing padding, font size, and styling for display.

classes.name: card
classes.description: A class for card components that includes background, border styling, and hover effects.
